title: Rural Home Loans Replacement Remittance Amount
content:
**Clause.** A replacement remittance on a Rural Home Loans loan is the monthly payment on the loan record, that is the monthly principal-and-interest payment plus the monthly escrow deposit, and it carries no fee. The amount is rounded to the cent.

## Restated as a definition

| Part | Amount |
|---|---|
| Principal-and-interest | the monthly principal-and-interest payment on the loan record |
| Escrow | the monthly escrow deposit on the loan record |
| Fees | none |
| Replacement remittance | the two parts added together, rounded to the cent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical loan records)

| Monthly principal-and-interest payment | Monthly escrow deposit | Replacement remittance |
|---|---|---|
| 1531.20 | 410.00 | 1941.20 |
| 2398.65 | 0.00 | 2398.65 |
| 987.33 | 265.17 | 1252.50 |

## Basis Q&A

**Which figures are read?** The monthly principal-and-interest payment and the monthly escrow deposit as they stand on the loan record when the remittance is figured.

**Does the replacement include unpaid fees?** No; it carries no fee.
